_comment: Which gateways this dashboard claims to work with, and the SDK it ships.
Read by the compat matrix in ci.yml, by the compat sweep and by
The supported range is DERIVED, never written down: the floor is the
lowest and the ceiling the highest `version` among the lanes with
required=true. There is deliberately no floor or ceiling key to keep in
step with the lanes. `python3 deploy/ci/sweep/sweep.py range` prints it.
lanes: releases pinned by digest (tag@digest: the tag is for readers, the
digest is what gets pulled). Required lanes run on every PR. Never pin a
dev build: a dev gateway resolves ghcr.io/nvidia/openshell/sandbox:dev at
runtime, so a digest-pinned dev lane still drifts with upstream HEAD and
broke main on 2026-10-02. A release resolves sandbox:<its own version>.
sdk: the exact version required in backend/go.mod, the commit of an
upstream release tag. CI fails when the two disagree.
sandbox_image: the workload image compat sandboxes run. It publishes no
version tags, so it is pinned by digest and held constant across lanes.
Two automated PRs edit this file and each touches one thing: the gateway
axis moves the ceiling lane, the SDK axis moves `sdk` (with go.mod).
